title: Focused node --test launcher records lack the provenance TermAl needs to credit them (request detached:false, tests stage runner node-test)
outcome: Focused node --test launcher records lack the provenance TermAl needs to credit them (request detached:false, tests stage runner node-test)
acceptance: A foreground focused launcher run writes `detached: false` in request.json and `runner: "node-test"` with numeric passed, failed and ignored counts on its Node tests stage; a detached run writes `detached: true`; every results.json stage records an absolute `cwd` equal to its execution directory, and launcher tests assert these fields.
One real foreground focused `node --test` launcher run in TermAl is recorded with a passed host verification (not Unknown), and a holder note quotes its record id

completion.summary: Launcher records now persist execution mode, absolute stage cwd and known focused Node runner/count provenance. Full nine-stage gate, independent Codex/Claude review pair and independent acceptance 754eabbbdfd54131884a9872ae634454 all passed on the frozen source. Real foreground TermAl verification e51015577e88408486085e7d9c7357e3 passed. Two Low findings retained as independent roots w-a6508e759899 and w-d50384229a72.
